bead.title: Wire tenant, queue, and custom headers into sink delivery
bead.description:
PROBLEM: TD-008 CL-7 requires each delivered change record to carry tenant/queue identity plus configured custom headers, but the current sink request construction is still partial and split from the validation path.
ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md:31-37 and crates/pqueue-server/src/change_record_sink.rs:78-143 show the delivery envelope and header assembly logic that still need to be finished together.
PROPOSED FIX: Complete the sink request builder so tenant and queue headers are always injected, configured custom headers are preserved, and the HTTP delivery envelope is built from one consistent request path.
NON-SCOPE: No Kafka consumer surface, no engine record-mapping changes, no retention-frontier changes, and no claim-path coupling; this remains a background delivery feature only.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestChangeRecordSinkWritesTenantQueueAndCustomHeaders` proves the sink emits tenant, queue, and configured custom headers.
2. `TestChangeRecordSinkBuildsDeliveryRequestWithTenantAndQueueMetadata` proves the request envelope carries the required queue identity metadata.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestChangeRecordSinkWritesTenantQueueAndCustomHeaders|TestChangeRecordSinkBuildsDeliveryRequestWithTenantAndQueueMetadata'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
